name: Fabio
epithet: Missionary of the Church of Seiros (true name Anacharsis)
personality: Rational but condescending, calls others 'beasts' and is drawn to suffering and clever talk.
story: Posing as a Church of Seiros missionary from Fodlan, he is actually an Agarthan named Anacharsis. He joins Dietrich automatically as a healer-companion; on Leda's route he needs Dietrich's paralogue 'Sealed-Off Past' and the 'They Have Lost' event. Reviewers praise his arc as genuinely moving.

personalSkill.name: Dark Calling
personalSkill.effect: Inflicts Dodge-5 on adjacent foes; range grows to 3 spaces by Lv 35.

tierNotes: KeenGamer: A tier. Pocket Tactics: S tier. Games with James: S tier, 'one of the best black magic users'.

why: Joins Dietrich's army automatically, so there's no Support or Renown to chase.

build.notes: Diviner in Ch 5, Shaman in Ch 6 (Black Magic C), Ovate in Ch 10 at Renown 8 (Black Magic B). Train Black Magic only; first Black-Magic Manuals go to him. Master Bind Dexterity, then Bind Speed. Dark Calling's Dodge -5 stacks with Bind Speed. Ovate beats the heavy armor that shows up in Part II.

guide.summary: Black Magic nuker and debuffer. Train Black Magic only, stack Dark Calling with the Shaman and Ovate binds, and use him as your answer to armor and enemy mages.

tips: Ch 4 and 5: point him at armored units
Do the Ch 5 Fabio scene in the eastern alleys; the Ch 10 scene needs it

watch: Caster: keep light. Wind 3 + Magic Staff 3 = 6 to Ch 9.
From Ch 10: Wind 3 + Electron Agitator 5 = 8 (Thunder 7: 12). No mask: the Turmoil Mask's 3 more points get him doubled. If he is doubled anyway, swap the Agitator for the Magic Staff first.
Weight (Part III): Death 13 + Agitator 5 = 18 over Bld ?. Doubled? Cast Miasma (5), then swap the Agitator for the Magic Staff (3) first.

decisions.pick: Ch 5 eastern alleys, Ch 10 at 18:00 near Temple Rows, Ch 12 alley east of the markets
decisions.why: Each scene needs the one before. The Ch 12 scene upgrades Dietrich's Answerer to Answerer Arisen (Mt 9 to 15?, Bloodletting+, repairs itself).
decisions.else: Miss the Ch 5 scene and the chain is gone: Dietrich duels Mars with Answerer

decisions.why: High A: Mag +20 and doubled Black Magic make him the main magic damage and the armor killer. Yang Jie, Olympia and Dante cover healing, and he has high Res for the mage side.

decisions.topic: Wear the Electron Agitator from Ch 11
decisions.why: Its confusion turns on Kiroc's Tyranny (Atk +3, Crit +10 vs a status). Wind 3 + Agitator 5 = 8 weight (Thunder 7: 12).
decisions.else: Back to the Magic Staff (3) if he gets doubled
